name: exa-foh
description: Local-network-first front-of-house system for EXA events and fixed venues.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n cloud,hub,boh,guest -c blue,cyan,green,magenta "npm run dev -w @exa-foh/cloud" "npm run dev -w @exa-foh/hub" "npm run dev -w @exa-foh/boh-dashboard" "npm run dev -w @exa-foh/guest-order"
scripts.dev:online: concurrently -n online,dashboard -c blue,cyan "npm run dev:online -w @exa-foh/cloud" "npm run dev:boh"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @exa-foh/shared && npm run build -w @exa-foh/cloud && npm run build -w @exa-foh/hub && npm run build -w @exa-foh/boh-dashboard && npm run build -w @exa-foh/guest-order
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @exa-foh/shared && npm run typecheck -w @exa-foh/cloud && npm run typecheck -w @exa-foh/hub && npm run typecheck -w @exa-foh/boh-dashboard && npm run typecheck -w @exa-foh/guest-order
scripts.verify:phase0: npm run typecheck && npm run build
